notes: Person page listing 27 theatre productions (1906-2024) where Mark Twain is credited as author, mostly adaptations 'd'après Mark Twain'; gives country and life dates, link to Wikipedia. Some listed shows are by other authors (Carrière, Boublil, Timmory) with Twain as co-credited source.
